author: screenrant
title: Tell Me Why Available for Free on Steam Until 2026
text:
DONTNOD Entertainment's narrative adventure Tell Me Why is free to keep on Steam until July 1, 2026, continuing an annual Pride Month tradition. The game, lauded for its heartfelt story and player choices, normally costs $19.99.
Steam users are no strangers to free games , as the platform frequently offers discounts, free weekends, and limited-time giveaways that expand enormous libraries. With the recent reveal of steep prices for upcoming Steam Machines, these complimentary titles have become even more valuable.
Among the latest offerings is Tell Me Why, a critically acclaimed narrative-driven adventure from DONTNOD Entertainment and Xbox Game Studios, which is currently available to keep for free until July 1, 2026. Released in August 2020, the game has earned a Metacritic score of 78 and a Very Positive rating from over 8,000 Steam reviews, praised for its emotional storytelling that explores sibling bonds, complicated relationships, and transgender identity in a small-town setting.
The title, split into three chapters, lets player choices shape its supernatural mystery and conclusion. This marks the sixth consecutive year Tell Me Why has been offered for free during Pride Month, aligning with its LGBTQ+ themes. For those who miss the giveaway, the game often appears in major Steam sales at steep discounts. At roughly ten hours to complete, it's an ideal short experience to enjoy over a weekend.
Beyond this title, Steam consistently hosts other free giveaways and deals, making it a top destination for PC gamers seeking quality content without cost
